title: The First Trial of the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the passage, a illusory figure condensed in the depths of the tomb—the appearance of Chen Xuan, yet bearing a terrifying pressure: 'Latecomer, you have finally arrived.'

text.content: A bone-chilling aura descended like a tangible force as Chen Ji stood behind the initial stone gate, confronting a sight that sent his pupils contracting. Countless coffins stretched before him, each emanating a dark bronze sheen, resembling dormant beasts lurking in this ancient darkness. Intricate runes crawled across the coffins like veins, weaving an expansive formation web that dominated the entire tomb. The air carried a stench of decay and antiquity, as if countless wandering souls whispered in the void. Chen Ji's fingers quivered—not from fear, but from excitement. He had waited far too long for this moment.

dialogue.content: "This is the Ten Thousand Souls Heaven-Sealing Formation." Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated from Chen Ji's Brow Center, carrying rare gravity. "Every coffin seals a remnant soul within—they were witnesses to Chen Xuan's campaigns of old, and they constitute this ruin's first trial. To pass through, you must make this formation web willingly part for you—forceful destruction will only add you to these ten thousand souls."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly warming within his Mental Sea. That familiar sensation of Heavenly Fate Value consumption surged forth—5 points, to glimpse the critical moments within the next three hours. He did not hesitate, allowing that force to explode at his Brow Center. In an instant, future visions flickered past like a carousel—the formation core lay in the southeastern direction, where an energy vortex imperceptible to the naked eye existed, the lifeline of the entire web.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record had indicated the formation core's location, but Chen Ji had to choose how to reach it—this would determine his expenditure in this trial.

choices.description: Forcefully tear through the formation web with one's own Spiritual Energy. Fastest, but extremely costly, and may awaken the dormant souls.
choices.visible_cost: Expend Spiritual Energy 30%, enrage the souls
choices.visible_reward: Quickly pass through, intimidate potential enemies
choices.risk_hint: Risk of Ten Thousand Souls Emerging

text.content: Chen Ji let out a low laugh as cyan Spiritual Energy condensed into a blade in his palm. His figure flashed like lightning, directly charging into the densest region of the formation web. The moment the Spiritual Blade passed through, the runes violently distorted, emitting piercing wails. The dormant coffins began to tremble, wisps of black mist spilling out—the souls were awakening. Yet Chen Ji did not stop; instead, he accelerated toward the southeast.

choices.description: Guide the formation's own energy as propulsion, go with the flow, minimal consumption but requires precise control.
choices.visible_reward: Spiritual Energy expenditure only 10%, maintain concealment

text.content: Chen Ji halted his steps, his gaze sweeping across those rune pathways. He rapidly calculated within his Mental Sea—this formation was fundamentally a circulation system, with absorption comes emission. Moments later, he sat cross-legged, using the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium, tearing a microscopic fissure on the formation web. The formation's instinctive repair mechanism immediately activated, energy surging toward the fissure like a tide, and Chen Ji slipped into that current.

choices.description: Activate the Tianji Record's complete analytical capabilities, simulate the formation's operational logic, find the perfect path.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete formation operation diagram, may discover additional opportunities

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, allowing the Tianji Record to burn within his Mental Sea. It was a sensation of his soul being extracted, Heavenly Fate Value draining like flowing water, but in exchange came unprecedented clarity—the entire formation web transformed into a complete meridian map before his eyes, every node, every energy flow, laid bare. He even glimpsed a hidden second entrance at the core—a backdoor Chen Xuan had deliberately left.

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji finally stood before the formation core. It was a crystal suspended in mid-air, chaos light swirling within, like an imprisoned heart. And carved upon the crystal, unmistakably, were ancient words—'Heavenly Secrets practitioner, exchange fate for Heavenly Secrets, is it permissible?' Chen Ji's heart lurched—this was precisely the truth he had always wished to know.

dialogue.content: Just at that moment, a cold voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind—it was an existence beyond, directly piercing through his Mental Sea. "Chen Ji, heir of the Tianji Record." The voice held no emotion, yet carried suffocating pressure. "You think you're a chess player? No, you are merely another piece I've placed. Every prophetic one believes they can rewrite fate, yet in the end, they all become part of destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but he quickly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart. Mo Xiansheng had said the Heavenly Secrets Eye had been watching him—but when truly facing this transcendent power, he realized how insignificant he was. Yet, insignificance didn't mean uselessness. His lips curved into a cold smile: "Since I'm a piece, then I'll be one that devours the entire game."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure descended upon Chen Ji like a tangible force, while the formation core awaited his response. He must choose how to confront this transcendent existence.

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record's power to counter the Heavenly Secrets Eye's suppression, displaying unyielding will.
choices.visible_reward: Comprehend the essence of the shackles during confrontation, gain resistance ability
choices.risk_hint: May trigger stronger sanctions from the Heavenly Secrets Eye

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment blazing with dazzling light in his Mental Sea. He no longer passively endured but actively rushed toward the oppressive force. The soul-level collision caused his seven apertures to bleed, yet the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure was momentarily shaken. "Is this the truth of the shackles?" he rasped with a laugh, "Using my Heavenly Fate as a chain in exchange for the ability to foresee the future—I will break this very chain!"

choices.description: Temporarily restrain one's edge, retreat to advance, secretly seek weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, discover the Heavenly Secrets Eye's surveillance blind spots
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Heavenly Secrets Eye

text.content: Chen Ji gathered his focus, seemingly enduring the pressure while secretly analyzing the operational patterns of this force. The Heavenly Secrets Eye's oppression was not impenetrable—it could monitor but lacked the ability to directly intervene. What did this indicate? It meant it was bound by certain rules, unable to personally destroy the prophetic one. This was both a shackle and protection. Chen Ji buried this discovery deep in his heart.

Just at the critical moment when Chen Ji confronted the Heavenly Secrets Eye, the crystal at the formation core suddenly shattered. An ancient and authoritative voice emerged from within, carrying the weight of ten thousand years: "Enough." With just these two words, the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure receded like a tide. Chen Xuan's remnant shadow gradually formed from the crystal fragments—a face bearing three-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, lacking Chen Ji's usual coldness, showing only profound weariness.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time with uncontrollable excitement: "Elder Chen Xuan! You've finally—" Before he could finish, Chen Xuan's remnant shadow raised a hand to stop him. "Mo Xiansheng, long time no see." Chen Xuan's gaze fell upon Chen Ji, as if observing a meticulously arranged artwork, "You've done well, better than I did at your age. Being able to see through the Heavenly Secrets Eye's true nature at the first trial—your shackles have loosened faster than I anticipated."

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly at this legendary ancestor, his voice terrifyingly calm: "So, what is the true nature of the shackles?" Chen Xuan's remnant shadow fell silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "The Tianji Record indeed trades Heavenly Fate for prophetic ability, but the true shackle lies not in the consumption—it lies in the fact that every prophecy is conducted under the watchful gaze of the Heavenly Secrets Eye. The future you see is the one it wants you to see."

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's remnant shadow continued, each word like a bell tolling from antiquity: "But you have one difference—your sister Chen Nian. The existence of the Heavenly Fate Key interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight. Those blurry visions are precisely the blind spots the Heavenly Secrets Eye cannot reach. This is a flaw, but also the only key to breaking the shackles." Chen Ji's heart tightened violently, and he thought of the girl taken by the Holy Sect, an unprecedented fury rising within him.

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan revealed the truth of the shackles—Chen Nian was the key to breaking them. Chen Ji must decide how to proceed.

choices.text: Immediately Inquire About Chen Nian's Whereabouts
choices.description: Chen Nian is Chen Ji's greatest weakness, immediately inquire about her specific location.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Xuan May Be Hiding Something

text.content: "Where is Chen Nian?" Chen Ji's voice was no longer calm—the first time his suppressed emotions for so many years showed so obviously. "Tell me, where is she?" Chen Xuan's remnant shadow looked at his descendant, a complex expression flickering in his eyes: "I cannot tell you her location directly, but I can tell you the entrance to the second trial. There, you will obtain more clues."

choices.description: Stay calm, first clarify all the truth about the ruins before searching for Chen Nian.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete information and the ruins map

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, taking three breaths to push the surging emotions back down into the depths of his heart. When he opened his eyes again, his gaze had returned to ice-cold: "Where is the entrance to the second trial? And, I need to know more about the Heavenly Eye." Chen Xuan's remnant shadow gave a slight nod: "Good. Being able to maintain rationality under such circumstances makes you more suited for this path than me." The remnant shadow raised his hand, and a beam of light sank into Chen Ji's Brow Center.

Chen Xuan's remnant shadow began to dissipate, but his voice still echoed within the tomb: "One last thing. When you find Chen Nian, you will face a choice—to use her Heavenly Fate Lock Key's power to completely break the chains, or to preserve her completeness. This choice has no right or wrong, only consequences." The moment the remnant shadow disappeared completely, a deep幽暗通道 revealed itself from where the formation core's crystal had shattered.

Chen Ji stood before the passage, feeling the oppressive force emanating from its depths. The pressure of the Ten Thousand Souls Seal Heaven Formation had vanished, replaced by a more pure power—ancient energy that seemed to awaken some dormant existence. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "The second trial is ten times more dangerous than the first. Are you certain you want to enter now? At your current state, your Heavenly Fate is already less than thirty points."

Chen Ji did not answer Mo Xiansheng's question. He lowered his head to look at his own hands, feeling the circulation of spiritual energy within his body, and the faint trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea. The chains had indeed loosened—not because his strength had increased, but because he had truly seen the full picture of these chains for the first time. From now on, every time he used the Tianji Record, he would carry this clarity. A cold smile curved his lips: "Let's go."

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the passage, a illusory image condensed in the depths of the tomb—the form of Chen Xuan, yet carrying a heart-stopping pressure. The image spoke, its voice ancient and majestic: "Successor, you have finally arrived." Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, his pupils constricting. Chen Xuan's remnant shadow slowly materialized at the entrance of the passage, that face bearing three points of resemblance to Chen Ji revealing no expression, only endless profundity.
